gaps.sentence: There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.

gaps.sentence: He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
___ (PERSIST) rain ruined the first two days of the festival.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'rain': persistent; 'persistence' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.
She gave a very ___ (CONFUSE) explanation of the rules.
gaps.explanation: 'Confusing' describes something that causes confusion; 'confused' describes the person affected.

gaps.sentence: The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.

gaps.sentence: The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.
